title: Create a Space is its own builder page at /create-a-space

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19 (project thread: Build four feature launch funnels): four builder pages, each its own feature, wired to the real feature; the old Create a Space page becomes Launch Your Business (LIVE-2471).

detail: /create-a-space is the Create a Space builder on the shared feature builder (LIVE-2481): the Space's name and address, its kind (business, or nonprofit and group), and one line, beside a live Space page preview, on a 5-minute clock. A member's Space is made at once through createSpace (makeSpace, every guard including the Crew rule once the beta ends), a taken address retried with a suffix, and the line saved with patchSpaceWords; a visitor signs in and /finish/space makes it. The temporary forward to /launch-your-business is gone; ROUTES.createSpace is this page again and ROUTES.launchBusiness carries the Theme Kit pages' kit buttons to the business builder. Copy says a free Space comes with Crew and that payments need Business.

verify.note: Fails while /create-a-space is missing or forwards away, or the builder does not make the Space through createSpace.
